title: Free literal positions
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $T$ be a DNF term on $n$ coordinates, and let each coordinate be assigned one of the restrictions free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$. A valid position $j$ in the literal list belongs to the set of free literal positions exactly when the coordinate of the literal at $j$ is assigned the free restriction.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a DNF term on $n$ coordinates
Each coordinate has a restriction chosen from free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$
$j$ is a valid position in $T$'s literal list
